page.overview:
Who is Ghavouri?

Ghavouri was a soldier of House Atreides.

Ghavouri fought in the Battle of Arrakeen, but was drugged by a group of conspirators and kept out of the battle. Feeling dishonored, he spent the next eight years tracking down and destroying them.

Ghavouri was approached by the Prisoner in The Griffin's Reach Tradepost. He was critical of their stance and offered to train them in combat. They agreed and he tasked them with killing the remaining conspirators, promising to train them if they accomplised this.
